chapters.title: Generator
chapters.text: Bovine Labs Context Generator is a Roslyn incremental generator. It skips assemblies named Bovine Labs Grove, Authoring, and Editor, but pulls public attributed methods from referenced Grove into your context switch.

chapters.title: Discovery
chapters.text: Context Filter requires partial struct implementing I Context of Self. Node Filter finds Execute Node, Data Node, and debug attributes. Context parameter must be ref; generic I Context matches all contexts.

chapters.title: Emit
chapters.text: Emits Create Generated, Update Generated, Set Chunk Generated from container field patterns, plus Execution Generated and Data Generated switches with Data T payload helpers.

chapters.title: Runtime
chapters.text: Execution Header Execute calls Execution Generated. Data Header Calculate may short-circuit built-in Grove Data Types before Data Generated. Unknown Type falls through to default.
